audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven phase reasons are still shared template text, and the page calls Karma 'his' in tldr, winCon, phases[1] and dosFull.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s, Inner Flame 9s at rank 1 over 950 range and Inspire 10s — none of those numbers reach the stages they decide.
audit.corrected: phases[1], [2], [3], [5] and [6] rewritten around the tether, the shield and the range gap, in second person with the right pronoun.

audit.why: phases[0] and phases[4] already carry the real spikes: Inner Flame's 9s and 950 range early, and the fact that Mantra needs no skill point so level 6 changes only your side. Nothing to add.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and winCon still tell you to shroud Focused Resolve, which is exactly backwards — the tether reveals its target, so Twilight Shroud does not answer it.
audit.why: Riot's description: Focused Resolve 'creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted'. report[5] and dosFull[0] on this page already say to break it by range or vision; the headline never got the correction.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, phases[1].why, tradeBad and breakdown.cooldowns now say break the tether rather than shroud it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns still lists no numbers and repeats the generic 'your committal tool / your ultimate' filler.
audit.why: Focused Resolve 12s flat, Inner Flame 9s at rank 1, Inspire 10s at rank 1, Mantra 40s at rank 1 and shortened by Gathering Fire on every damaging spell.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with those four numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood, tradeBad and dosFull[1].d are still the shared template, and tradeGood calls Karma 'his'.
audit.why: Template copy that survived the earlier pass over the dontsFull entries.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to this matchup, with Akali's real 110 energy Q cost.

edits.before: Weather the poke — shroud his Focused Resolve and burst the gap. Akali wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — break her tether before it roots, then burst. Akali wins the Focused Resolve windows.

edits.before: Shroud his Focused Resolve and burst the gap. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Break Focused Resolve and burst the gap. It is a flat 12s and it reveals you, so smoke is not the answer here.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Shroud is not safety here: Focused Resolve reveals you, and the tether roots unless you break it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Inspire shields her through a partial rotation — open with Q, commit once the shield is gone.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: break the 12s tether with distance or terrain, because your E dash is the only thing that beats the root.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight while her Focused Resolve is still on its 12s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Karma carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and one rotation kills her, but she shields and peels for a team — take her alone, never in a fight.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (12s): it reveals you, so break the tether with distance or terrain instead of shrouding it. - Inner Flame (9s): 950 range of poke. - Inspire (10s): the shield to burst through. - Mantra (40s) shortens on every damaging spell.

edits.before: Q Karma at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q her at 550, E-mark and dash in once Focused Resolve is spent, then Shroud her Inner Flame.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Sitting in smoke while she tethers you — the reveal finds you and the root lands regardless.

edits.before: Q Karma at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — poke on the regen, not on every step she takes.

notes: Only 42 recorded games at Emerald+, so I wrote nothing that leans on the 53.65% figure. Part of this matchup had already been improved on disk between my first read and my write — phases[0], phases[4], breakdown-adjacent dosFull[0] and all three dontsFull entries already carry real numbers — so I edited only the paths still holding template text and left the good work untouched.
